gt-row-03.question: What is the total market value of all active holdings, grouped by party?
gt-row-03.executed_sql:
SELECT R3.FULL_NAME AS "FULL_NAME1m365", SUM(CAST(R1.MARKET_VALUE AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS "sum1"
FROM NORMALIZED.HOLDING R1, NORMALIZED.COVERAGE R2, NORMALIZED.PARTY R3
WHERE ((('PARTY#' || R2.PARTY_ID) = R3.PARTY_ID) AND R1.MARKET_VALUE IS NOT NULL AND R2.PARTY_ID IS NOT NULL AND R3.PARTY_ID IS NOT NULL AND R3.FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND R2.COVERAGE_ID IS NOT NULL AND R3.GOVT_ID IS NOT NULL AND R1.HOLDING_ID = R2.HOLDING_ID AND 'Active' = R1.HOLDING_STATUS)
GROUP BY R3.FULL_NAME
ORDER BY SUM(CAST(R1.MARKET_VALUE AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) DESC NULLS LAST
gt-row-03.expected_sql:
SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.full_name AS party_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT h.holding_id) AS holding_count,
    SUM(h.market_value) AS total_market_value
FROM normalized.holding h
JOIN normalized.coverage c
    ON h.holding_id = c.holding_id
JOIN normalized.party p
    ON CONCAT('PARTY#', c.party_id) = p.party_id
WHERE h.holding_status = 'Active'
  AND h.is_deleted = false
  AND c.is_deleted = false
  AND p.is_deleted = false
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.full_name
ORDER BY total_market_value DESC
LIMIT 10

gt-row-00.question: Show me policies where the insured party is also the policyholder.
gt-row-00.expected_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT h.holding_id, h.policy_id, lp.party_id AS insured_party_id
FROM normalized.holding h
JOIN normalized.life_participant lp 
  ON lp.holding_id = h.holding_id
JOIN (
  SELECT holding_id, party_id
  FROM normalized.life_participant
  WHERE is_deleted = false
  GROUP BY holding_id, party_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT participant_sk) > 1
) dup 
  ON dup.holding_id = h.holding_id 
  AND dup.party_id = lp.party_id
WHERE lp.is_deleted = false 
  AND h.is_deleted = false

gt-row-01.question: For each rider, who are the insured participants and what are their roles?
gt-row-01.executed_sql:
SELECT R3.COVERAGE_ID AS "COVERAGE_ID1m63", R4.FULL_NAME AS "FULL_NAME1m365", R4.GOVT_ID AS "GOVT_ID1m357", R1.HOLDING_ID AS "HOLDING_ID1m512", R1.IS_DELETED AS "IS_DELETED1m524", R2.IS_DELETED AS "IS_DELETED1m547", R2.PARTICIPANT_SK AS "PARTICIPANT_SK1m549", R4.PARTY_ID AS "PARTY_ID1m373", R3.PARTY_ID AS "PARTY_ID1m89", R1.RIDER_NAME AS "RIDER_NAME1m532"
FROM NORMALIZED.RIDER R1, NORMALIZED.RIDER_PARTICIPANT R2, NORMALIZED.COVERAGE R3, NORMALIZED.PARTY R4
WHERE ((('PARTY#' || R3.PARTY_ID) = R4.PARTY_ID) AND LOWER(CASE     WHEN R2.IS_DELETED = true THEN 'true'
    WHEN R2.IS_DELETED = false THEN 'false'
    ELSE NULL 
END) = 'false' AND LOWER(CASE     WHEN R1.IS_DELETED = true THEN 'true'
    WHEN R1.IS_DELETED = false THEN 'false'
    ELSE NULL 
END) = 'false' AND R1.RIDER_NAME IS NOT NULL AND R1.IS_DELETED IS NOT NULL AND R2.PARTICIPANT_SK IS NOT NULL AND R2.IS_DELETED IS NOT NULL AND R3.PARTY_ID IS NOT NULL AND R4.PARTY_ID IS NOT NULL AND R4.FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND R3.COVERAGE_ID IS NOT NULL AND R4.GOVT_ID IS NOT NULL AND R1.HOLDING_ID = R2.HOLDING_ID AND R1.HOLDING_ID = R3.HOLDING_ID)
ORDER BY R1.RIDER_NAME NULLS FIRST, R4.FULL_NAME NULLS FIRST
gt-row-01.expected_sql:
SELECT
    r.rider_id,
    r.rider_name,
    r.rider_code,
    r.rider_type,
    r.rider_status,
    r.holding_id,
    c.coverage_id,
    c.coverage_type   AS participant_role,
    c.party_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(p.full_name, ''), CONCAT(p.first_name, ' ', p.last_name)) AS participant_name,
    p.party_type,
    c.issue_age,
    c.issue_gender,
    c.underwriting_class
FROM normalized.rider r
JOIN normalized.coverage c
    ON r.holding_id = c.holding_id
LEFT JOIN normalized.party p
    ON c.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE r.is_deleted = false
  AND c.is_deleted = false
ORDER BY r.rider_id, c.coverage_id
LIMIT 10

gt-row-08.question: What was the total financial-activity amount per month in 2024?
gt-row-08.executed_sql:
SELECT SUM(CAST(R3."TRANSACTION_AMOUNT1m159" AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS "sum1", R3."v3" AS "v3"
FROM (SELECT R1.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT AS "TRANSACTION_AMOUNT1m159", SUBSTRING(R1.TRANSACTION_DATE,1,7) AS "v3"
FROM NORMALIZED.FINANCIAL_ACTIVITY R1
WHERE (SUBSTRING(R1.TRANSACTION_DATE,1,LENGTH('2024')) = '2024' AND LOWER(CASE     WHEN R1.IS_DELETED = true THEN 'true'
    WHEN R1.IS_DELETED = false THEN 'false'
    ELSE NULL 
END) = 'false' AND R1.TRANSACTION_DATE IS NOT NULL AND R1.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT IS NOT NULL AND R1.IS_DELETED IS NOT NULL AND R1.ACTIVITY_ID IS NOT NULL)
) R3
GROUP BY R3."v3"
ORDER BY R3."v3" NULLS FIRST
gt-row-08.expected_sql:
SELECT
    SUBSTR(transaction_date, 1, 7) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    SUM(CAST(transaction_amount AS DOUBLE)) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM normalized.financial_activity
WHERE SUBSTR(transaction_date, 1, 4) = '2024'
  AND is_deleted = false
GROUP BY SUBSTR(transaction_date, 1, 7)
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 12

gt-row-07.question: Show the top 10 parties by total holding market value, including the investment product names they hold.
gt-row-07.executed_sql:
SELECT R1.FULL_NAME AS "FULL_NAME1m365", R1.GOVT_ID AS "GOVT_ID1m357", ARRAY_JOIN(ARRAY_DISTINCT( ARRAY_AGG(R4.FUNDNAME)) , ', ') AS "str", SUM(CAST(R3.MARKET_VALUE AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS "sum1"
FROM NORMALIZED.PARTY R1
 JOIN 
NORMALIZED.COVERAGE R2 ON 1 = 1 
 JOIN 
NORMALIZED.HOLDING R3 ON (R1.GOVT_ID = CONCAT('PARTY#',R2.PARTY_ID) AND R1.FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND R3.MARKET_VALUE IS NOT NULL AND R1.GOVT_ID IS NOT NULL AND R2.COVERAGE_ID IS NOT NULL AND R2.HOLDING_ID = R3.HOLDING_ID) 
 LEFT OUTER JOIN 
NORMALIZED.HOLDING_SUBACCOUNT R4 ON (R4.FUNDNAME IS NOT NULL AND R2.HOLDING_ID = R4.HOLDING_ID) 
GROUP BY R1.FULL_NAME, R1.GOVT_ID
ORDER BY SUM(CAST(R3.MARKET_VALUE AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
gt-row-07.expected_sql:
SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.full_name                                                        AS party_name,
    SUM(h.market_value)                                                AS total_market_value,
    ARRAY_JOIN(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT
        CASE
            WHEN hs.fundname IS NOT NULL THEN hs.fundname
            WHEN pp.product_name IS NOT NULL THEN pp.product_name
            ELSE 'N/A'
        END
    ), ', ')                                                           AS investment_products
FROM normalized.party p
JOIN normalized.coverage c
    ON c.party_id = REPLACE(p.party_id, 'PARTY#', '')
    AND c.is_deleted = false
JOIN normalized.holding h
    ON h.holding_id = c.holding_id
    AND h.is_deleted = false
LEFT JOIN normalized.holding_subaccount hs
    ON hs.holding_id = h.holding_id
    AND hs.deleted = false
LEFT JOIN normalized.policy_product pp
    ON pp.product_code = c.product_code
    AND pp.is_deleted = false
WHERE p.is_deleted = false
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.full_name
ORDER BY total_market_value DESC
LIMIT 10

gt-row-04.question: For policies that have a payout schedule, show the policyholder's name, the payout frequency, and the projected next-payout amount.
gt-row-04.executed_sql:
SELECT R3.FULL_NAME AS "FULL_NAME1m365", R4.PREMIUM_MODE AS "PREMIUM_MODE1m448", SUM(CAST(R5.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS "sum1"
FROM NORMALIZED.ANNUITY_DETAIL R1, NORMALIZED.COVERAGE R2, NORMALIZED.PARTY R3, NORMALIZED.POLICY_PRODUCT R4, NORMALIZED.FINANCIAL_ACTIVITY R5
WHERE (LOWER(CASE     WHEN R5.IS_DELETED = true THEN 'true'
    WHEN R5.IS_DELETED = false THEN 'false'
    ELSE NULL 
END) = 'false' AND ((R5.ACTIVITY_TYPE = 'Withdrawal') OR (R5.ACTIVITY_TYPE = 'Dividend') OR (R5.ACTIVITY_TYPE = 'Claim')) AND LOWER(CASE     WHEN R2.IS_DELETED = true THEN 'true'
    WHEN R2.IS_DELETED = false THEN 'false'
    ELSE NULL 
END) = 'false' AND LOWER(CASE     WHEN R1.DELETED = true THEN 'true'
    WHEN R1.DELETED = false THEN 'false'
    ELSE NULL 
END) = 'false' AND ('PARTY#' || R2.PARTY_ID) = R3.PARTY_ID AND R1.DELETED IS NOT NULL AND R2.PARTY_ID IS NOT NULL AND R2.IS_DELETED IS NOT NULL AND R3.PARTY_ID IS NOT NULL AND R3.FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND R4.PREMIUM_MODE IS NOT NULL AND R5.ACTIVITY_TYPE IS NOT NULL AND R5.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT IS NOT NULL AND R5.IS_DELETED IS NOT NULL AND R2.COVERAGE_ID IS NOT NULL AND R3.GOVT_ID IS NOT NULL AND R4.PRODUCT_ID IS NOT NULL AND R5.ACTIVITY_ID IS NOT NULL AND R1.HOLDING_ID = R2.HOLDING_ID AND R2.PRODUCT_CODE = R4.PRODUCT_CODE AND R1.HOLDING_ID = R5.HOLDING_ID)
GROUP BY R4.PREMIUM_MODE, R3.FULL_NAME
ORDER BY R3.FULL_NAME NULLS FIRST
gt-row-04.expected_sql:
SELECT
    p.full_name                                         AS policyholder_name,
    COALESCE(pp.premium_mode, c.product_code)           AS payout_frequency,
    fa.transaction_amount                               AS projected_next_payout_amount,
    fa.effective_date                                   AS payout_effective_date,
    fa.activity_type                                    AS payout_type,
    ad.holding_id                                       AS policy_id
FROM normalized.annuity_detail ad
JOIN normalized.coverage c
    ON c.holding_id = ad.holding_id
   AND c.is_deleted = false
JOIN normalized.party p
    ON p.party_id = CONCAT('PARTY#', c.party_id)
   AND p.is_deleted = false
LEFT JOIN normalized.policy_product pp
    ON pp.product_code = c.product_code
   AND pp.is_deleted = false
LEFT JOIN normalized.financial_activity fa
    ON fa.holding_id = ad.holding_id
   AND fa.activity_type IN ('Withdrawal', 'Dividend', 'Claim')
   AND fa.is_deleted = false
WHERE ad.deleted = false
ORDER BY ad.holding_id, fa.effective_date DESC
LIMIT 10
